svg.title: Known-best packing of 303 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=303 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 511f56b rational centre/half-angle dilation certificate in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, converted from a checkout at the gist's pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=303 known best: side ~ 17.90976233 (certified upper bound)
